section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces a study by Raphaela Kellner and Mathias Benedek that investigated the independent contributions of intelligence and creativity to humor production. The study involved 151 participants who generated punch lines for cartoons. The findings indicated that both crystallized intelligence and creative potential (divergent thinking fluency) uniquely predicted the funniness of humor productions, suggesting that these domain-general abilities independently contribute to humor.
